tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions are as per the bid document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover in all classes of engineering works only of Rs.41.90 in the last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26. Annual turnover certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant with valid UDIN. Certificate without UDIN or UDIN not verified online would be rejected
Bidder should have GST registration certificate. Form GST REG-06 to be submitted. GSTIN/UIN not verified online would be rejected

Bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least one similar work/service such as SITC/operation/maintenance of Wetwells/STP/I&D infrastructure for minimum of Rs.20.95 between 2021-22 and the last date of bidding for any local body/Govt./Semi Govt./PSU. Work done / service rendered certificate duly certified by the officer not below the rank of Executive engineer or equivalent.
Bidder should have Valid Electrical contractor license of Class-2 or above. Duly issued by the Govt. Electrical Inspectorate. License not verified online would be rejected

Bidder should provide any Training certificate in sewage/waste water/used water management duly issued by an institution of any State/Central Govt. Dept. in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to last date of bidding.
Letter Comprising Bid. As per Schedule-I of the bid document.
Site Inspection Declaration. As per Schedule-V of the bid document.
Undertaking for not-blacklisting. As per Schedule-II of the bid document.
